title: Restrict Time Sensitive notifications to current events

statement.en: Use the Time Sensitive interruption level only for an event happening now or within an hour.
statement.ja: Time Sensitive interruption levelは現在発生中または1時間以内に発生するeventだけに使う。

conditions: The notification is relevant in the moment and requires immediate attention.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Managing notifications experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるManaging notificationsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
